TRAFFIC ADVISORY

Special traffic arrangements will be in place from 19.11.2025 to 25.11.2025 for the celebration of the 350ᵗʰ Martyrdom Day of Shri Guru Teg Bahadur Sahib Ji at Red Fort. Heavy footfall and increased vehicular movement are expected in the area.

📍 RESTRICTIONS & DIVERSIONS:
-Traffic on Netaji Subhash Marg and Nishad Raj Marg may be restricted as per ground requirements
-Buses and commercial vehicles from Delhi Gate/Chhata Rail Chowk side may be diverted towards Ring Road between 4 PM – 11 PM
-Additional point diversions may be imposed from Chhata Rail Chowk, GPO Chowk, Delhi Gate, Shanti Van Chowk, Hanuman Mandir Crossing and T-Point Subhash Marg.
📍 PARKING:
-Visitors to Red Fort & Chandni Chowk are advised to use designated parkings including Parade Ground, ASI Parkings, Dangal Maidan, Omaxe Mall, Church Mission Road and Service Road near Shanti Van.
📍 ADVISORY TO COMMUTERS:
-Avoid affected stretches such as Ring Road (Rajghat–Chandgiram Akhara), Netaji Subhash Marg, Nishad Raj Marg, SPM Marg, Lothian Road & Boulevard Road. 
-Prefer public transport/Metro and follow the directions of traffic personnel
📍Stay updated through Delhi Traffic Police channels.

data.text:
THE DEMAND IS SIMPLE: TRANSPARENCY. The Presidency Is Not a Family Secret—It Is a Constitutional Office.

Every president of the Republic is held to the highest standards of probity and integrity—not by whim, not by politics, but by constitutional design. He alone, by his lonesome and in person, wields enormous and concentrated executive power. He alone is Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces. No Senate. No House. No Supreme Court justice exercises that magnitude of unilateral power.

This is the very reason the 1987 Constitution is explicit and uncompromising: Article XI, Section 1 — Public Office Is a Public Trust.

All public officers and employees, even men and women in uniform, at all times, should be accountable to the people and serve them with utmost responsibility, integrity, loyalty, dignity, and efficiency.

When senators, congressmen, or justices falter, they falter with institutional buffers around them. But when the President is compromised and falters, the entire nation is exposed and compromised. The entire security architecture becomes vulnerable. The entire economy trembles.

SEN. IMEE’S MARCOS STATEMENT IS NOT A “FAMILY DRAMA.” IT IS EVIDENCE!

Senator Imee Marcos’ revelation—that her own brother, the sitting president, along with his wife and children, suffers from drug addiction—was made in public with a plea for her brother to step down, take care of his health, and go home. 

This is NOT idle gossip. This is highly probative testimony from a senator of the Republic and a close family kin at that, directed at the chief executive of the country, and delivered without the shield of parliamentary privilege.

Add to this the allegation that the President is allegedly involved and the “mastermind” in a massive scandal involving the insertion of 100 billion into the national budget alongside enormous corruption in his own government, and this matter immediately becomes a question of NATIONAL SECURITY, GRAVE NATIONAL CONCERN, and ECONOMIC SURVIVAL, NOT some petty Marcos family feud.

If the commander-in-chief is impaired and compromised—politically, psychologically, or chemically—then:

•Decision-making is compromised,
•The national security calculus is distorted,
•Foreign policy becomes unpredictable and erratic
•and the machinery of governance becomes exposed to manipulation and exploitation

This is institutional instability at the topmost level of government.

A Hair Follicle Test Is Not OPTIONAL. It Is the Minimum Standard of Accountability.

Drug allegations at this level cannot be addressed by flippant denials, PR spin, or staged photo-ops. Only a hair follicle test—administered independently and transparently—can restore credibility.

Every PSG personnel, police officer, military recruit, government employee, and private company staff can be compelled to undergo drug testing. Why should the Commander-in-Chief—the most powerful individual in the country—be exempt? If he is clean, he has nothing to fear, nothing to hide! 

If he is not, the Filipino people deserve to know—now, not after the country collapses under compromised leadership and a rotten to the core corrupt government! 

THE WORLD IS WATCHING — AND THEY ARE NOT AS EASILY FOOLED.

International investors, credit-rating agencies, development lenders, and foreign governments read foreign press, not local spin. They rely on:

•governance risk reports
•corruption exposure assessments
•political instability indicators
•leadership vulnerability analyses

A sitting president hounded by unresolved corruption and drug addiction allegations is a perfect storm for sovereign risk. Expect:

•higher borrowing costs,
•capital flight,
•tighter credit-rating outlooks,
•investor hesitation,
•and massive reputational damage to the Philippines.

No global analyst will be reassured by “I deny the allegations.” They will demand evidence. They will look at the silence or evasiveness as confirmation of political instability and breakdown of governance.

THE PRESIDENCY IS NOT PERSONAL PROPERTY. IT IS A PUBLIC OFFICE.

The Filipino people deserve certainty—not a leader clouded by serious allegations, not a family shielding itself from scrutiny, not a nation left to guess the fitness of its Commander-in-Chief and chief executive of the Republic of the Philippines. 

The call stands: TAKE A HAIR FOLLICLE TEST. ACCOUNTABILITY AND TRANSPARENCY NOW!! NO BUTS! NO EXCUSES! NO DELAYS!

If every ordinary Filipino can be required to prove they are drug-free to keep their job, then the President of the Republic must be held to the same standard—if not higher.
This is not political noise.
This is constitutional accountability.
This is national security.
This is economic survival.
This is global credibility.
And above all,
This is the right of the Filipino people—to know the truth.

Failure to Launch 

The attempt to destabilize the government through civil action was an epic fail.

Zaldy Co's flawed expose was supposed to trigger massive support for the weekend rallies.

The result:
1) INC couldn't call a million warm bodies.
2) DDS were barred from joining the INC rally
3) INC cut short its 3 day rally to 2 which removed the umbrella that would have hidden more sinister actions 
4) The EDSA rally barely had any attendees

Chavit, Guanzon and Imee's speeches got more hate than support.

Zaldy's maleta story is dead in the water. Sass and Sonza couldn't resurrect it even with the massive DDS troll farms.

Lacson's interpolation of Bernardo's affidavit and letter to the President took over the news. 

This effectively erased all the noise from the Zaldy Co expose. Heads rolled and roles were reversed in one week.

Zaldy Co the new DDS hero is back to being the villain that he is.

Marcos and Romualdez are exonerated.

Sara waiting in the wings for a coup d'etat that never happened goes back to the drawing board.

China’s Hybrid Warfare and Disinformation Frontiers

The 2025 U.S.–China Economic and Security Review Commission report presents a sweeping assessment of China’s evolving economic, military, technological, and informational challenge to the international order. 

It portrays a China facing deep internal economic strain property sector collapse, weak consumption, rising youth unemployment, and a two-speed economy driven by excessive state-led industrial capacity yet simultaneously projecting greater assertiveness abroad. 

Beijing has doubled down on export-oriented manufacturing, generating massive overcapacity that is flooding global markets with ultra-cheap goods, creating what the Commission terms a “China Shock 2.0.” 

This new wave threatens manufacturing bases from Southeast Asia to Europe and the United States, deepens dependency on Chinese supply chains, and reinforces Beijing’s ability to weaponize economic leverage.

Militarily, China continues accelerating modernization across all domains nuclear, space, cyber, maritime, missile forces, and dual-use technologies like AI and quantum computing. 

Its coercive actions have intensified: from aggressive maneuvers near Taiwan to unprecedented gray-zone operations in the South China Sea, targeting the Philippines, Japan, and regional stability more broadly. 

Beyond Asia, China is reshaping the global security environment by enabling Russia’s war in Ukraine, supporting Iran’s regional activities, and strengthening North Korea’s missile and cyber capabilities.

These four China, Russia, Iran, North Korea form an emerging axis of aligned autocracies, mutually reinforcing each other while blunting Western sanctions and diplomatic pressure.

The report also highlights China’s growing influence operations worldwide. Beijing employs cyber intrusions, economic coercion, elite capture, social media manipulation, and AI-driven disinformation to shape narratives, weaken U.S. alliances, and promote its preferred global norms. 

One example, relevant to South Asia’s evolving geopolitical environment, surfaced after the India–Pakistan clash around Operation Sindoor. As various regional militaries assessed battlefield performance, Chinese embassies aggressively promoted claims that Pakistan had downed Indian aircraft purportedly Rafales with Chinese-supplied systems. 

French intelligence confirmed this was part of a broader Chinese disinformation campaign aimed at undermining confidence in French Rafale fighters and steering foreign militaries toward Chinese alternatives such as the J-35. 

AI-generated “debris” images and fabricated videos were circulated through bot networks, and the pressure campaign even contributed to Indonesia pausing an ongoing Rafale purchase. 

The report frames this not as a South Asia–specific operation but as part of Beijing’s global practice of exploiting conflicts to advance commercial, diplomatic, and geopolitical interests through narrative manipulation.

Regionally, China is embedding itself deeply into Southeast Asia and the Pacific Islands by financing critical infrastructure, telecommunications networks, energy grids, ports, and police cooperation agreements. 

These moves create long-term dependencies, grant Beijing access to dual-use facilities, and undermine long-standing U.S. partnerships. 

Chinese crime-syndicate-linked scam centers, growing influence in internal security institutions, and the spread of surveillance technology further expand China’s leverage.

The Commission concludes that China’s challenge is multidimensional economic, military, technological, informational, and ideological. Beijing’s strategy blends industrial overreach, coercive diplomacy, rapid militarization, cyber infiltration, and disinformation into a coherent model of global power projection.
